title: Degenerate higher-time-derivative Hamiltonians
question: Classify polynomial scalar Lagrangians whose Hessian in highest time derivatives is degenerate enough to avoid an extra propagating degree of freedom.
first_test: Derive a complete Dirac constraint count for a restricted polynomial family.

title: Constraint preservation under nonlinear evolution
question: Determine whether a primary degeneracy constraint in a higher-derivative scalar theory is preserved under a nonlinear interaction.
first_test: Prove secondary consistency or exhibit a constraint-breaking flow.

title: Finite-wavelength stability with Lorentz breaking
question: For a stable quadratic scalar theory with preferred-frame spatial derivatives, determine the minimal derivative structure producing a unique nonzero wave-number minimum.
first_test: Derive positivity and uniqueness conditions for its full dispersion symbol.

title: Ghost elimination by auxiliary fields
question: Classify when introducing one auxiliary scalar rewrites a fourth-order effective action into a positive-energy second-order system.
first_test: Prove exact equivalence or a no-go result under frozen interaction assumptions.

title: Causal propagation in dispersive field theories
question: Determine whether a fourth-order spatial derivative field equation admits finite signal speed or only a specified dispersive propagation bound.
first_test: Establish a sharp propagation estimate for compactly supported data.

title: Hyperbolicity under parameter continuation
question: Classify regions where a real fourth-order temporal symbol remains strongly hyperbolic as its coefficients vary.
first_test: Prove an algebraic criterion and identify instability boundaries.

title: Higher-derivative effective field theory cutoff
question: For a prescribed low-energy derivative expansion, find the largest frequency window where the truncated fourth-order model approximates a stable parent evolution.
first_test: Prove a cutoff-dependent error bound and an example of breakdown.

title: Energy positivity for coupled scalar fields
question: For a two-field quadratic Lagrangian with mixed time and spatial derivatives, classify positive Hamiltonian conditions after eliminating constraints.
first_test: Produce a matrix positivity test necessary and sufficient in a specified gauge.

title: Derivative nonlinearities and local well-posedness
question: Determine Sobolev regularity thresholds for a fourth-order dispersive equation with a quadratic derivative coupling.
first_test: Prove a contraction estimate or norm-inflation counterexample.

title: Gauge compatibility of phase curvature interactions
question: Determine which local phase-curvature couplings can be inserted into a gauge-covariant wave Lagrangian without breaking gauge invariance.
first_test: Classify operators under a fixed derivative cutoff.

title: Hamiltonian reduction near a spectral degeneracy
question: Determine when eliminating a heavy stable mode produces a controlled quartic spatial dispersion for a remaining light field.
first_test: Derive the reduced symbol and error estimate to fixed order.

title: Boundary conditions for fourth-order field energy
question: Classify self-adjoint and energy-conserving boundary conditions for a fourth-order spatial scalar operator on a bounded smooth domain.
first_test: Relate boundary forms to positive quadratic energy.

title: Nonlocal parent actions and stable effective dispersion
question: Determine whether a positive nonlocal parent kernel can yield an effective finite-wavelength minimum without ghost degrees of freedom.
first_test: Construct a spectral representation or prove positivity restrictions.

title: Spectral factorization of stable field symbols
question: Characterize positive quartic-in-frequency dispersion polynomials that admit a factorization into healthy lower-order branches.
first_test: Prove necessity and sufficiency with explicit coefficients.

title: Vacuum stability under higher-gradient interactions
question: Determine whether nontrivial spatially patterned vacua minimize a positive-energy higher-gradient scalar field theory.
first_test: Prove a modulated-vacuum existence theorem or restore homogeneous minimality.

title: Higher-order Noether currents
question: For a fourth-order spatial Lagrangian with continuous symmetries, derive conserved currents and determine their coercive control of solutions.
first_test: Prove conservation identities and expose boundary terms.

title: Quasilinear fourth-order continuation criteria
question: Determine whether bounded critical Sobolev norms prevent finite-time loss of regularity in a specified quasilinear fourth-order wave system.
first_test: Prove a continuation theorem with exact norm assumptions.

title: Constrained Hamiltonian numerical integrators
question: Construct a discrete evolution scheme preserving the Dirac constraint manifold and approximating the corresponding stable field dynamics.
first_test: Prove discrete constraint preservation and convergence.

title: Coupled dispersion crossing and mode conversion
question: For two stable scalar branches with a tunable avoided crossing, quantify nonlinear energy transfer near their resonance.
first_test: Derive a finite-dimensional normal form with error bounds.

title: Physical observables after field redefinitions
question: Determine which scattering or spectral observables remain invariant under invertible local derivative field redefinitions at a fixed EFT order.
first_test: Prove the equivalence and quantify truncation errors.
